title: How far a pilgrim's health summary can be trusted abroad
description: The ordered states of Kamal's International Patient Summary along the pilgrim's journey, from held at home to read and used in the host country. Each state includes the ones before it. The journeys viewer draws it as the trust ladder ("Follow the record").

codes.label: Held at home
codes.definition: In Onesa's health information exchange; nothing is shared.

codes.label: Consented
codes.definition: Kamal has agreed to share his summary for Hajj.

codes.label: Signed
codes.definition: Assembled, signed with a key GDHCN trusts, and in his wallet as a QR code.

codes.label: Presented
codes.definition: The QR code is shown to a health worker abroad.

codes.label: Verified
codes.definition: The signature is checked against the GDHCN trust list.

codes.label: Read and used
codes.definition: A clinician abroad reads the summary and treats him; a rendered copy stays with the visit.
